comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Walkthrough (google translated):

Chapter 1 "Mercenary Captain"
Genoa → (1 day sailing) Genoa → Naples (talk to Andrea at sea to start the battle)
1st battle: Spanish transport ship
2nd battle: Naples garrison (5 combat carracks)
Both battles are supported by 3 Dorian mercenaries,
earn 1,000,000 ducats.

Chapter 2 "Bold Decision"
Ionian Sea (just west of Naples) → (unknown number of days required for sailing) Naples → Naples Tavern → Genoa → Mansion at the bottom left of the Genoa map

Chapter 3 "One Victory, One Loss"
Genoa → In front of the Genoa port → In the Tyrrhenian Sea (just east of Tunis), there is a battle with a suspicious galley (Barbarian galley *2). The Dorian fleet (heavy galley *3) provides support
→ Genoa → (60 days of sailing) Genoa → In the Ionian Sea (in front of the northeast bay (Gulf of Patras))
→ In the Ionian Sea (from the front of the northeast bay to the south), there is a battle with an Ottoman fleet (Turkish galley *5). There is support from the combined fleet → Genoa

Chapter 4 "Final Glory"
Genoa → Genoa Tavern → (60 days required for sailing) Genoa →
Battle with Ottoman fleet (5 Arabian galleys) in the Ligurian Sea (in front of Calvi) Dorian fleet (4 heavy galleys) provides support

Ends with this.
Evasion skill limit: 20 → 21

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?TheLivesOfHeros/AndreaDoria
